Demo feedback from Jack Heart on the dashboard, 2026-11-22: "msising a breadcrumbs so when i click on an experimetn/sweep/report i can get back to the main talble". At aff12d7 /experiments/NAME and /experiments/NAME/report have no breadcrumb; the only way back is the rail. Add a breadcrumb to every page below a top-level list: Experiments › NAME on the experiment page, Experiments › NAME › Report (or Reports › NAME when reached from /reports) on the report page, Experiments › NAME › RUN on the run page, each part a link. Notes: scratch/demo-notes.md.
